content: Jesúsma isu'cho
Ande na'su Agosto na'suite tiseja manda poi ande'su a'ima agattoye.
Me'ttia'ye tsa'caen agattoye mandasi Cirenio tsu Siria ande'su governaror.
Poiyi'cco tsu tise a'i canqqueni ja'faya'cho tseni tise'pa inisema tevaensi cuintsu agatto'faye.
Tsa'cansi Joséja Galilea ande'su Nasaret canqquene sombopa Judea andeni ja. Joséja David a'ipa Judeani japa Belén canqqueni ja. Tsa canqque tsu tayopi'su Na'su Davidma isu'cho canqque.
Nane tise pushe Maríai'ccu tseni tise'pa inisema tevaeñe ja'fa. Maríaja tayo suri.
Tsa'cansi toya Beléni can'jen'ni tayo tsu María du'shuma isuya'cho napi.
A'i ana'jen'cho tsa'o panshaen on'basi vaura ettini can'jemba Maríaja tseni tise aishe tsandie du'shuma isu. Isupa sarupai'ccu findipa vaura an'jen'cho cafonga ppiña.
Chigama sefacconi'su shondosundeccu attian'fa'cho
Beléni pporotsse tsu can'jen'fa oveja coirasundeccu. Cose potreroni can'jen'fa tise'pa ovejama coiraye.
Tse'faei'ccuyi Na'su Chigama sefacconi'su shondo'su tise'panga attian. Attiansi na'su Chiga a'tatssiaja tise'panga chanjun. Tsa'caen chanjunsi ñoa'me dyo'fa.
Tsa'ma Chigama sefacconi'su shondo'suja su: —Dyo'fajama. Ñotsse condase'choma condaye gi ji. Poiyi'cco a'i tsu vama pañamba avujatssi'faya.
Ja'ño a'ta tsu David canqqueni que'ima ccushaen'suve isu. Tsaja Na'su Cristo tsu.
Nane ña su'cho du'shumanda qui atte'faya sarupai'ccu findipa vaura an'jen'cho cafonga ppiña'choma.
Tise tsa'caen su'je'ni tse'faei'ccuyi tsain'bio Chigama sefacconi'su shondosundeccu tisei'ccu fae'ngae attian'fa. Tsa'caen attiamba Chigama ñotsse afapa su'fa:
Sefacconi'su Chigaja ñoa'me ñotssia tsu.

content.text: Va ande'su aindeccuma ñotsse in'jamba Chigaja in'jan cuintsu poiyi'cco a'i tisupapora ñotsse in'jamba opatsse canse'faye.

content: Tsa'caen afa nanimba poiyi'cco Chigama sefacconi'su shondosundeccu ja'fasi oveja coirasundeccu tisupaporai'ccu condasecco'fa: —Jinge Beléni jaye. Na'su Chiga va ñotsse tson'choma inginga condase'choma japa atteye.
Cunshoa'me japa Maríama, Joséma'qque cachui'fa. Tsomba du'shuma'qque atte'fa, vaura an'jen'cho cafonga ppiña'choma.
Du'shuma attepa du'shune tise'panga condase'choma condase'fa.
Oveja coirasundeccu tsa'caen condase'fasi poiyi'cco pañasundeccu asi'ttaemba can'boen'fa.
Tsa'ma Maríaja osha'choma in'jamba injama'choni asi'ttaén can'jen.
Tsomba ovejama coirasundeccu toequi japa Chigama ñotsse afa'fa. Nane Chigama sefacconi'su shondo'su ma'caen conda'choma tayo pañamba tsa'caen attepa Chigama avujatsse afa'fa.
Jesúsma Chiganga afe'fa'cho
Ocho a'ta pasasi du'shumbe ttonoma chhiyitevaemba tisema inisian'fa Jesúsve. Tsa'caen tsu Chigama sefacconi'su shondo'suja tayoe conda María toya surimbi'te.
Moisés manda'cho mandaqquia'caen pushesu asettupa onjoña'chone napisi Maríaja onjon. Onjomba du'shu Jesúsma Jerusaléni anga'fa tisema Chiganga afeye.
(Na'su Chiga manda'cho tsu su: Majan aisheve isu'cho tsandie du'shumajan tsama Chigaja in'jan Tise'beve.)
Toya'caen Na'su Chiga manda'cho tsu manda dos ppuppuju'choma, tsambi'ta dos manambema Chiganga afeye. Tsa'caen manda'chosi María, José tsama afeye ji'fa.
Tsaite Jerusaléni fae tsandie can'jen, tise inise Simeón. Tiseja ño'amba Chigama ñoa'me in'jan. Chiga Qquendya'pa tisei'ccu can'jensi tiseja israendeccuma ccushaeña'chove ronda'je.
Toya'caen Chiga Qquendya'pa tisema in'jaemba conda, tiseja toya pambi'te Na'su Chigambe Cristoma atteya.
Tsa'caen condapa in'jaensi Chiga ettini ja. Tseni japa can'jen'ni María, Joséi'ccu du'shu Jesúsma i'fa manda'cho suqquia'caen tisema tsoñe.
Tsa'caen i'fasi attepa Simeónjan du'shuma opipa Chigama ñotsse afapa qquen su:

content.text: Queja poiyi'cco a'inga tisema moen cuintsu attepa in'jan'faye.
Nane tiseja israembindeqquianga attiansi tsendeccu'qque queve in'jan'faya.
Tise'qque israendeccu'susi israendeccuja ti'tsse'tssia've dapa avujatssi'faya.

content: Simeón tsa'caen susi José, María pañamba can'boen ccutsu'fa.

Tsonsi Simeón tise'pama ñotsse afapa du'shumbe chan Maríama su: —¡Que canjan! Va du'shuve in'jambi'ta tsain'bio israendeccu tsu qque'faya. Tsa'ma cca'indeccuja tise've in'jamba ti'tsse'tssia've dapa tsu avuja'faya. Aindeccu tisema afase'fasi
qui dansan'choi'ccu que injama'choma quiccu'fa'ma'caen injama'cho tsosipie ñombi'yeya. Nane tsain'bio a'i tsu tise'pa injama'cho tsosipie in'jan'choma tsa'caen poiyi'cconga canjaen'faya.

Toya'caen Chiga Aya'fama afa'su pushesuja Chiga ettini can'jen. Aser aindeccu'su Fanuel onque'nge tsu. Tise iniseja Ana. Tiseja ñoa'me ccashe, ochenta y cuatro canqque'fave tsu an'bian. Tseyi coemba tsa'ndupa siete canqque'fave can'jensi tise tsa'nduja pa. Tsa'caen pan'jaemba ja'ñojan Chiga ettini can'jen. Ni sombombi. Tsa'ma a'ta, cose'qque tseni can'jemba Chigama iñajan'jen. Maqui a'taja ambe'yi Chigama iñaján canse.

Simeón toya José, Maríai'ccu condase'je'ni Ana'qque jipa cachui. Cachuipa du'shuma attepa Chigama ñotsse afapa du'shu Jesúsne Jerusalensundeccunga condaseye ashaen. Condasesi majan Chiga ccushaeña'chove ronda'je'chondeccuja ñotsse paña'fa.
Toequi Nasaretni ja'cho
Tsonsi pa'ccoma Na'su Chiga manda'cho mandaqquia'caen tsomba María, José, du'shui'ccu toequi Galileani ja'fa. Tise'pa Nasaret canqqueni japa can'jen'fa.
Du'shu Jesús coenjimba quinsetssia've da. Chiga tisema ñotsse in'jansi osha'choma atesupa in'jan.
Jesús chuite Chiga ettini ja'cho
Jesús chan, tisema coeña'su yaya'qque poi canqque'fa Jerusaléni jaye atesu'fa Chiga panshaen'cho injienge'cho fiestama panshaeñe.
Jesús doce canqque'fave napiansi ccase tise'pa in'janqquia'caen fiestani jayipa Jesúsma'qque anga'fa.
Fiestama panshaemba toequi Galileani jayi'fasi Jesúsja toe Jerusaléni shanda. Tsa'caen shandasi tise chan, tise yaya'qque atesumbe'yi tsu jaja'fa.
Jesúsja tayo tise amigondeccui'ccu ja qquen in'jamba jaja'fa. Tsa'caen in'jamba fae a'ta já cosepa tise've ttatta'fa. Antiandeccu, amigondeccuni japa ttatta'ma attembi.
Attembipa toequi Jerusaléni ttattaye ja'fa.
Tsa'caen toequi japa tres a'ta tta'ttá jacamba tisema atte Chiga ettini Chiga manda'choma atesiansundeccui'ccu condasé dyai'choma. Nane atesiansundeccu su'choma pañamba osha'chove iñajampaña'jen.
Jesúsja osha'choma in'jamba tsa'caen condasesi poiyi'cco majan tisema pañasundeccu can'boen'fa.

Tsa'caen tson'jen'ni Jesús chan, tise yaya'qque tisema attepa can'boen ccutsupa Jesús chanjan su: —Jaricho, ¿jongoesie qui ingima a'tu maña? Tsa'caen que a'tu mañasi ingija ñoa'me ñombi'yepa tta'ttá vana'jen'fa.
Tsa'ma Jesús tise'pama su: —¿Jongoesie qui ñame ttatta'je'fa? ¿In'jan'fambi ti qui ñajan ña Quitsa tsaoni can'jemba semaña'cho?
Tsa'ma tsa'caen susi tise su'choma ñotsse paña'ma in'jan'fambi.
Tsa'caen supa Jesúsja tise'pai'ccu Nasaretni ja. Tseni japa tise'pama ñotsse pañamba canse. Toya'caen Jesús chanjan osha'choma in'jamba tisu injama'choni asi'taén can'jen.
Jesúsja ti'tsse coemba osha'choma atesu. Poi a'i tisema ñotsse in'jan'fa. Chiga Quitsa'qque tisema ñotsse in'jan.
